## What changed

### Tooling installed

`syft 1.44.0` was downloaded via the official Anchore install script to `~/.local/bin/syft`. No system-wide install (no apt; no sudo).

```bash
curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anchore/syft/main/install.sh | sh -s -- -b ~/.local/bin
```

Verified: `syft --version` reports `syft 1.44.0`.

### Full SBOM regen artifacts

| Format | Path | Size |
|--------|------|------|
| SPDX JSON | `sbom-results/2026-05-08-syft.spdx.json` | 5.3 MB |
| CycloneDX JSON | `sbom-results/2026-05-08-syft.cyclonedx.json` | 3.0 MB |

Per repo convention `sbom-results/` is gitignored — the actual JSON artifacts
live there as regenerable build outputs; only this delta doc is committed.

Single command:
```bash
cd ~/tmp/unheaded
syft scan dir:. -o spdx-json=sbom-results/2026-05-08-syft.spdx.json \
                -o cyclonedx-json=sbom-results/2026-05-08-syft.cyclonedx.json
```

Runtime: ~30 seconds.

### Headline numbers vs 2026-05-06 delta-only

| Metric | 2026-05-06 (delta) | 2026-05-08 (full syft) |
|--------|--------------------|------------------------|
| Go modules (`go list -m all`) | 100 | (subset of below — syft groups by ecosystem) |
| Rust packages (max workspace) | 337 (zhend) | (subset of below) |
| **Syft total package count** | n/a (no syft regen) | **2,149** |
| Top licenses | n/a | NOASSERTION 2083 / BSD-3-Clause 31 / MIT 18 / Apache-2.0 3 / GPL-3.0-only 1 |

The "NOASSERTION" count of 2083 is largely Go transitive deps where the upstream module did not ship a LICENSE file recognizable by syft's classifier. This is a **known limitation of file-only license detection** — ScanCode does deeper SPDX header + boilerplate matching and would resolve many of these. Filed for daytime: install ScanCode + cross-reference, expected to drop NOASSERTION count by 80-90%.

## Wave A/B/D impact on SBOM surface

This regen reflects today's drain-shift commits:

- **trace-collector tonic 0.10 → 0.12** (Wave A) — tonic 0.12.3 + prost 0.13.5 replace tonic 0.10.2 + prost 0.12.x. ~30 transitive package version bumps in `cmd/trace-collector/Cargo.lock`.
- **prometheus 0.13 → 0.14** (Wave A protobuf-disable) — prometheus 0.14.0 replaces 0.13.4; legacy `protobuf 2.28` (RUSTSEC-2024-0437) removed from the trace-collector dep graph entirely.
- **zhend pqcrypto FIPS 205/203** (Wave B) — `pqcrypto-mldsa 0.1.2` + `pqcrypto-mlkem 0.1.1` replace `pqcrypto-dilithium 0.5.0` + `pqcrypto-kyber 0.8.1`. Fragment-encryption + peer-auth code paths now align with FIPS 205/203 standardized names.
- **rustls-webpki 0.103.10 → 0.103.13** (carried from 2026-05-07 Wave A pre-engagement) — also in this regen.

## Daytime tooling roadmap (scancode + cyclonedx-cli)

`scancode-toolkit` is the deeper license-detector but has heavyweight system deps (libxml2, libxslt, libpython3-dev) that need `apt-get install` (sudo). Install procedure:

```bash
sudo apt-get install -y python3-pip libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev libsasl2-dev libpython3-dev
pip install --user scancode-toolkit
~/.local/bin/scancode --version

# Generate SPDX with deep license detection
scancode --spdx-tv docs/sbom/2026-05-08-scancode.spdx.tv \
         --json-pp docs/sbom/2026-05-08-scancode.json \
         --license --copyright --info --packages \
         --processes 4 \
         --classify --license-clarity-score \
         <repo-root>
```

Runtime: ~30-60 minutes (much slower than syft because of per-file classifier).

`cyclonedx-cli` is a Go binary (Apache-2.0) for producing/transforming CycloneDX SBOMs. syft already produces CycloneDX format, so cyclonedx-cli is mainly useful for VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) authoring and SBOM merging:

```bash
go install github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-cli@latest    # ~15s
~/go/bin/cyclonedx-cli --version
```

Both can be added to `scripts/install-sbom-tools.sh` as a one-shot setup script.
